verdicts.reason: A is just the banner row pasted into the top of a taller canvas. The bottom ~40% is empty orange, the 'Try It' button is jammed against the right edge and floats unaligned, and 'Out now.' drifts far below the headline. B rearranges the design: headline on the left, product and CTA on the right. But the CTA pill is oversized and almost touches the product circle, and 'Out now.' is stuck next to the button as an orphan instead of sitting under the headline. The headline is also somewhat small against the large product disc.
